title: Rename Coord to Coordinate
description: Rename the domain type `Coord` to `Coordinate` across all semio language implementations (py, ts, rs, cs, go, rb, graphql, jsonschema, openapi, xmi, liveblocks, assets, AGENTS.md). The AGENTS.md spec already standardizes on `Coordinate` (section "Coordinate" at line 2312, class `Coordinate` at line 701), but many source files still use the abbreviation `Coord`. Apply word-boundary aware substitution covering: Coord->Coordinate, Coords->Coordinates, coord->coordinate, coords->coordinates. Preserve already-correct `Coordinate` tokens. Do not touch ticket folders, session logs, cursor plans, or other historical artifacts. Run test suites per implementation to confirm.
